goal: Local Git, local checks, and Evaluator evidence update the owning WorkItem so customer progress comes from executed evidence
scenarios: developer links the current local Git commit to a WorkItem without GitHub
developer runs local typecheck and test and those results attach as CI evidence
Evaluator records criterion-level evidence on the WorkItem
customer delivered appears only when executed evaluator, CI, or Git checks pass on the current design revision
Generator self-check, notes, and stale evidence after analysis or design change cannot mark the customer view delivered
constraints: core operation does not require GitHub
manually entered summaries cannot masquerade as executed checks
Generator self-check cannot mark the slice complete
nonGoals: hosted GitHub, Gitea, or GitLab adapters
branch creation and pull request write path
